verdict.rationale: Bench documents that you can "Give secure access to your Bench account with unlimited logins," so a founder could plausibly grant an outside accountant a login. Nothing shows role-scoped permissions or that an external party can adjust the books. Bench's client surface is described as reports and downloads, and its bookkeeping is done by Bench's own team. Missing for 10: role-based or scoped permissions, an explicit external accountant/bookkeeper invite flow, edit or adjustment rights for invited users, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Give secure access to your Bench account with unlimited logins.
